Emily Chen: Heads-up: AetherStack proposed a joint launch for their marketplace connector + a 30-min panel webinar featuring a customer case study. They want the listing live the same week as the blog. Can we scope assets and lead routing? :sparkles:
Rajiv Kumar: Love it. Whos the customer for the case study? engineering or product buyers?
Priya Singh: They suggested BrightBridge (platform eng). That gives us a dev+SRE audience. Panel format = Aether product lead + BrightBridge eng + our solutions engineer.
Tom O'Leary: Timing constraints? Aether wants week of 2025-08-18. Doable if we lock content by 8/8.
Emily Chen: Proposed timeline: content freeze 8/8, rehearsal 8/13, webinar 8/18, blog + listing 8/20. Ops: how do we tag leads by origin and intent?
Priya Singh: Recommend three buckets: webinar-attendee, marketplace-click, case-study-download. Map to lead owners and initial tags.
ops-bot: Suggested UTM mapping template created: https://docs.example.com/utms/aetherstack-launch
Rajiv Kumar: Draft routing matrix (will A/B headline CTAs):
```
source,utm_campaign,initial_owner,lead_tag
webinar,aether-panel-0818,SDR-web,attendee
marketplace,aether-listing-0820,AE-partner,marketplace-click
case_study,aether-case-0820,Content-SDR,download
```
Priya Singh: Also want a lead scoring rule: +2 if watched >50% of webinar, +3 if requested demo, +1 if marketplace click. Score >=4 -> AE outreach.
Tom O'Leary: For the marketplace listing we need three assets: short description (50-120 chars), 3 feature bullets, and integration diagram PNG (800x600). Emily can handle copy, I will produce the diagram.
Emily Chen: Messaging experiments: Variant A headline: "Integrate LLM inference into your platform pipeline with sub-100ms p95" Variant B: "Handle 10k concurrent LLM requests with predictable cost" Well run headline A/B on the landing page and marketplace snippet (if Aether supports).
Priya Singh: Benchmarks for case study: use BrightBridge production traces for 24h window; compare Redwood Dedicated vs their prior self-hosted setup. Capture cost per 100k tokens, p50/p95, and failure rate under burst. Publish anonymized tables.
Rajiv Kumar: Legal note: co-branded case study needs BrightBridge approval + Aether trademark usage. I'll send the agreement draft to legal by 7/30. Need signoff by 8/5.
ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal slot reserved 2025-08-13 09:00 PT. Join link: https://meet.example/room123 (auto).
Tom O'Leary: Webinar runbook: fallback plan = recorded demo clip + live Q&A; slide deck to include 1-sheeter with CTA link to case study and scheduling form. Ill mock slides by 8/6.
Emily Chen: KPI goals: 500 registrants, 150 attendees, 40 MQLs, 8 SQLs. Conversion rules documented in the Notion page Ill create. Budget ask: co-op spend = $5k for joint ads. Aether confirmed 50/50 split.
Priya Singh: Action items recap:
- Emily: Landing copy + Notion hub + marketplace snippet (due 8/6)
- Rajiv: Legal + routing matrix + campaign params (due 7/30)
- Tom: Integration diagram + slides + runbook (slides 8/6, runbook 8/11)
- Priya: Benchmark data pulls + anonymized tables (datasets by 8/1)
- ops-bot: Set reminders and publish UTM templates (automated)
Emily Chen: If no objections Ill create the Notion and tag owners. Also flagging PR for product marketing to draft an embargoed press blurb. :thumbsup:
Rajiv Kumar: +1
Priya Singh: +1
Tom O'Leary: +1
Emily Chen: Great. Ill post the Notion link once ready and ping Aether for their marketplace asset spec. Thanks team! :rocket:
